upload_large_folder: upload a large local folder to a Hugging Face Hub repository with resumable upload support
upload_large_folder_include: upload a large folder to the Hub matching specific glob patterns with the include option
upload_large_folder_exclude: upload a large folder to the Hub excluding files matching specific glob patterns with the exclude option
upload_large_folder_workers: upload a large folder to the Hub using multiple workers for parallel hashing and uploading
upload_large_folder_resume: resume an interrupted large folder upload to the Hub that picks up where it left off
